topic: Writing about a Change(写一篇关于某种变化的短文)
genre: 说明 / 议论(predict something that will disappear + reasons + supporting arguments)
source: 外研社新标准选择性必修二 Unit 3 Developing ideas:写一篇关于变化的短文——选一样你认为未来会消失的事物,说明原因并给出支持理由。
prompt_cn: 时代在变,有些事物正悄悄退出我们的生活。请用英语写一篇约100词的短文,内容包括:① 指出一样你认为未来会消失的事物;② 说明它消失的主要原因;③ 给出一两条支持你观点的理由。注意:行文连贯、围绕中心,适当用上过去进行被动语态(如 was being replaced)。
prompt_en: Times are changing, and some things are quietly disappearing from our lives. Write a passage of about 100 words including: 1) one thing you think will disappear in the future; 2) the main reason why it will disappear; 3) one or two arguments to support your view. Try to use the past continuous passive (e.g. was being replaced) where it fits naturally.
points: 点明会消失的事物(I believe … will soon disappear.)
说明主要原因(The main reason is that …)
给出支持理由(What's more, … / Besides, …)
围绕中心、衔接自然,适当用过去进行被动
model_essay: I believe the printed paper map will soon disappear from our daily lives. The main reason is simple: we no longer need it. Almost everyone now carries a mobile phone that can show the way at the touch of a button. Last year, when I visited a bookshop, I noticed that the shelves of paper maps were already being replaced by other goods. What's more, a phone map is always up to date, while a paper one quickly becomes old. It is also far lighter to carry. So, like the phone box before it, the paper map is becoming a thing of the past.
model_translation: 我认为纸质地图很快会从我们的日常生活中消失。原因很简单:我们不再需要它了。如今几乎人人都带着手机,一按键就能指路。去年我逛书店时,注意到摆放纸质地图的货架已经在被其他商品取代。而且,手机地图总是最新的,纸质地图却很快过时,携带起来也轻便得多。于是,就像之前的电话亭一样,纸质地图正在成为过去。

rubric.criteria: 三要素齐全:点出消失之物 / 主要原因 / 支持理由
围绕一个事物展开、句句相关、衔接自然、行文连贯
句型词汇准确多样、过去进行被动等运用得当、语法基本无误

required_structure: 点题 I believe … will soon disappear.
原因 The main reason is that …
收束 …, it is becoming a thing of the past.
key_expressions: I believe the printed paper map will soon disappear.
The main reason is simple: we no longer need it.
The shelves of paper maps were already being replaced by other goods.
Like the phone box before it, the paper map is becoming a thing of the past.

high_sentences: I believe the printed paper map will soon disappear from our daily lives.
The shelves of paper maps were already being replaced by other goods.
A phone map is always up to date, while a paper one quickly becomes old.
Like the phone box before it, the paper map is becoming a thing of the past.

error_pairs.wrong: The maps were replacing by other goods.
error_pairs.correct: The maps were being replaced by other goods.
error_pairs.note: 过去某刻'正被替换',主语是承受者,用 was/were being done,而非主动 -ing。

error_pairs.wrong: We don't need it no more.
error_pairs.note: 避免双重否定;no longer = 不再。

error_pairs.wrong: The paper map is becoming a thing of past.
error_pairs.correct: The paper map is becoming a thing of the past.
error_pairs.note: 固定短语 a thing of the past,需带 the。

paragraph_template:
【关于变化的短文结构】
第1句 点题:I believe … will soon disappear.
第2-3句 原因:The main reason is … (可用过去进行被动举例 … was being replaced …)
第4-5句 理由:What's more, … Besides, …
第6句 收束:…, it is becoming a thing of the past.
